content:
Overview

Linköping is a city in Östergötland with a population of 162,000. A growing tech and aviation hub, home to Linköping University and Saab’s aerospace headquarters. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
